name: BioAPI
description:
# 🧬 Welcome to BioAPI BioAPI unifies biomedical datasets behind a consistent, queryable interface. Use familiar operators to filter, paginate with cursors, and receive predictable JSON responses across all endpoints. > [!tip] > New to the API? Read through this short guide below. **Read time: 5-10 minutes** --- # 🔑 Authentication Include your API key in the `X-API-Key` header with every request: ```bash curl https://api.bioapi.dev/v1/endpoint \ -H "X-API-Key: your_api_key_here" ``` **Example with fetch:** ```javascript fetch('https://api.bioapi.dev/v1/users', { headers: { 'X-API-Key': 'your_api_key_here' } }) ``` > [!note] > You can view or create your API key in the [dashboard](https://bioapi.dev/dashboard/keys). Keep it secure and never commit it to version control. --- # 🚀 Quick Start ### Base URL ``` https://api.bioapi.dev/v1 ``` ### Basic Request ```bash curl "https://api.bioapi.dev/database/press-releases/fda/rss?limit=5" \ -H "X-API-Key: your-api-key" ``` ### Python Example ```python import requests headers = {"X-API-Key": "your-api-key"} params = {"limit": 10, "pub_date.gte": "2024-01-01"} response = requests.get( "https://api.bioapi.dev/database/press-releases/fda/rss", headers=headers, params=params ) for item in response.json()["data"]: print(item["title"]) ``` ### JavaScript Example ```javascript const response = await fetch( 'https://api.bioapi.dev/database/press-releases/fda/rss?limit=10', { headers: { 'X-API-Key': 'your-api-key' } } ); const { data, total, next_token } = await response.json(); console.log(`Found ${total} results`); ``` --- # 🔍 Filtering & Querying ### Basic Filters Use equality for exact matches: ```http ?status=active&country=US ``` ### Operators Append operators for advanced filtering: #### String Operators | Operator | Description | Example | |----------|-------------|---------| | `field` | Exact match | `?name=John`| | `field.regex` | Regular expression | `?name.regex=^J.*` | | `field.like` | Pattern match
(case-sensitive) | `?name.like=%John%` | | `field.ilike` | Pattern match
(case-insensitive) | `?name.ilike=%john%` | #### Numeric & Date Operators | Operator | Description | Example | |----------|-------------|---------| | `field` | Exact match | `?age=18` | | `field.gt` | Greater than | `?age.gt=18` | | `field.gte` | Greater than or equal | `?age.gte=18` | | `field.lt` | Less than | `?age.lt=65` | | `field.lte` | Less than or equal |`?age.lte=65` | #### Nullable Operators Applies to all parameters marked *nullable* regardless of type: | Operator | Description | Example | |----------|-------------|---------| | `field.isnull` | Field is null | `?email.isnull=true` | ### Date Range Example ``` # Inclusive start, exclusive end pattern ?pub_date.gte=2024-01-01&pub_date.lt=2024-02-01 ``` > [!NOTE] > Use ISO 8601 format for dates: `2024-01-01` or `2024-01-01T12:00:00Z` ### Multiple Values Pass multiple values as CSV (comma-separated) or repeated parameters: ```bash # CSV format ?classification=ClassI,ClassII # Repeated format ?classification=ClassI&classification=ClassII ``` > [!NOTE] > Only base equality filters (`field=value`) accept multiple values. Operators like `field.gt=value` take a single value. --- # 📑 Pagination - `limit` controls page size (default `100`, max `1000`). - When more results exist, a `next_token` is returned. - Pass `next_token` back with the same query to fetch the next page. ```bash # First page curl "https://bioapi.dev/database/endpoint?limit=100" \ -H "X-API-Key: your-api-key" # Next page (use token from previous response) curl "https://bioapi.dev/database/endpoint?limit=100&next_token=abc123" \ -H "X-API-Key: your-api-key" ``` > [!WARNING] > Pagination Tokens are query-specific. If you change filters, start fresh without `next_token`. --- # 📋 Response Format All endpoints return consistent JSON: ```json { "data": [{ /* records */ }], "limit": 100, "total": 1234, "next_token": "abc123..." } ``` | Field | Description | |-----|-------------| | `data` | Array of results matching your query | | `limit` | Page size used for this request | | `total` | Total number of matching records | | `next_token` | Token for fetching the next page
(not included if no more results) | --- # 🌐 Database Endpoints **Base path:** `/database` BioAPI aggregates data from multiple biomedical sources: - **FDA** — Press releases, MedWatch, Drugs@FDA, enforcement actions - **ClinicalTrials.gov** — Study registry data - **DailyMed** — SPL labeling information - **Orange Book / Purple Book** — Reference datasets - **Industry news** — Drugs.com, PharmaLive feeds Endpoints are grouped by coverage area below. > [!success] > Endpoints are updated on their own cadences and normalized into consistent models for downstream use. --- # 💬 Questions or Issues? Contact us at [support@bioapi.dev](mailto:support@bioapi.dev).
